agent.pathAnalysis.name: Search Journey Analysis
agent.pathAnalysis.desc: Analyses the search journey consumers take from keyword to keyword, as routes and branch points (hubs).
pathAnalysis.dash.flowDesc: The journeys that appear most often starting from '{category}', drawn as a branching tree with the largest flows first. Shared openings are merged, and the points where they split are the branch points (hubs).
pathAnalysis.dash.pathSectionDesc: High-volume journeys, sorted by flow type (converging to purchase, stuck in comparison, risk and drop-off).
pathAnalysis.dash.hubSectionDesc: The keywords where several routes split apart. What a customer chooses here shapes the rest of the journey.
customerAnalysis.purpose.body: This report analyses the search journey consumers take starting from '{category}', to reveal the routes customers travel in the {market} market and where they branch, drop off or convert. Keyword-to-keyword routes were collected from ListeningMind PathFinder search journey data, and the main routes and key branch points (hubs) were derived from search volume.
customerAnalysis.purpose.bodyNoMarket: This report analyses the search journey consumers take starting from '{category}', to reveal the routes customers travel and where they branch, drop off or convert. Keyword-to-keyword routes were collected from ListeningMind PathFinder search journey data, and the main routes and key branch points (hubs) were derived from search volume.
